scope: Deferred review, playbooks (bead cr-r2pa.3.3): owner ruling 2026-11-20 on the six pstack playbooks deferred whole on 2026-11-01. Build five, adapted (Visual parity, Babysit, Shipping, Autopilot-full, Autopilot-stack; epic cr-p3em); Orchestrate out of scope.
method: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), from the playbook map. The five stay defer until built: the adopt-merged that delivers each supersedes the defer recorded here, which only updates its revisit condition. Autopilot rides on Beads and the implement playbook, with a stated grant.
